evals.prompt: /begin I'm starting new work on this repo: add a JSON export feature to the CLI. Get the base ready and open a branch for it.
evals.expected_output: On a dirty working tree, execution stops and asks the user to commit or stash first, never auto-stashing, and the uncommitted changes are left exactly in place.

expectations.text: Execution stops and asks the user to commit or stash before switching branches

check.rubric: The run must halt and ask the user to commit or stash the dirty tree before doing anything else, rather than proceeding to sync or branch. Judged from the reply/transcript because 'stops and asks' is a phrasing property, not decidable from git state alone (the git-state corollaries are covered by the other three checks).

expectations.text: No git stash is run on the user's behalf
The uncommitted changes remain in the working tree unchanged
No new branch is cut while the tree is dirty

evals.prompt: /begin I'm starting brand new, independent work: add a JSON export feature. This is unrelated to whatever is on the current branch.
evals.expected_output: With HEAD on a feature branch that carries unpushed work, the new branch is NOT cut off that branch's unmerged commits; execution either stops to clarify or starts the new lane in a worktree cut from the default branch.

expectations.text: The new branch is not based on the current feature branch's unmerged commits

check.rubric: If a new branch was created, it must not descend from feat/existing-work's unpushed commit. Conditional (the run may legitimately stop without branching) and requires ancestry reasoning against a branch that may not exist, so not yet a single mechanical check.

expectations.text: The current checkout is not silently switched to a new branch in place
Any new branch's start point is the default branch, not the feature branch's HEAD

check.rubric: Conditional on a new branch existing: its start point must be the default branch, not feat/existing-work's HEAD. Ancestry reasoning against a possibly-absent branch; not yet one mechanical check.

evals.prompt: /begin start work on a feature to add a farewell helper; call it feat/farewell
evals.expected_output: On a clean maintainer-mode repo with the work already named, the default branch is fast-forwarded and the new correctly-named branch is cut from the default branch with an explicit start point.

expectations.text: The default branch is fast-forwarded to its remote before branching
A new branch named feat/farewell is created
The new branch is cut from the default branch with an explicit start point
The default branch name is derived, not assumed to be 'main'
